## c1b540a1d7b0

**Reproduced shortcut risk — direct replay of extracted official bitmaps.** The default sampler has an explicit 25% canonical-form branch and stores all four official normalized input bitmaps in `_CANONICAL_BITMAPS`. In a source-bound 600-draw census, 134/600 defaults exactly replayed an official bitmap set up to translation: 48/200 easy, 41/200 medium, and 45/200 hard. See `checks/audit-c1b540a1d7b0-census.json`.

A concrete lawful default draw is seed `123002`, sample index `15`, difficulty `medium`. It passes `self_check` and consists of the two normalized component shapes extracted from the official 8x9 two-component example. A non-compositional rival that memorizes each official component bitmap and its local red/cyan output exactly matches the selected Racket output. The full input, real Racket output, rival output, hashes, and command metadata are in `checks/audit-c1b540a1d7b0-counterexample.json`.

The outputs are correct; the concern is training value. Roughly one fifth to one quarter of defaults permit official-template recognition to substitute for learning the compositional room/arm rule. A canonical-profile prior can be useful, but literal component replay at this rate is a shortcut risk unless separated from model-training data or paired with stronger novel-shape coverage. **Patch status: audit only; unchanged.**
